modes: absolute claim off a centred quantity
a contaminated control prints the same string as a real leak
a control validated by its own instrument's noise

the sham is a poison, not a placebo

reproducibility.defect: vocab was built by iterating sets of strings, so the decoy floor followed PYTHONHASHSEED and moved between identical runs
reproducibility.fix: tokens sorted before the vocabulary list is built
reproducibility.caught_by: running the same script twice and diffing the floor

bound: shared tokens are not shared mechanism; coverage is bounded from ABOVE
live_limitation: the definition describes the instance; one release, one core
